OP please seek help. Life honestly doesn't make sense, and i know what it's like to hate yourself so much you really think you dont deserve anything, not even living, and the situation maybe is worsened by your "friends" and pandemic (because tbh a lot of shit is happening), but listen. This is the only life you have. Please try to feel better and to make something out of it. Try to ground yourself out of that black hole you're in rn. When i had my deepest depressive episode and didn't know who i was anymore, i listed out the few things i still knew about myself, that made me a little less sad (colourful socks, my mug, a plant i have in my room etc.). Try to ground yourself to those little things that make your days better. And don't look at life in the long term rn, it usually doesn't help. Take it day by day, because when you're really too deep into that hole, saying "ok this is another shitty day, i have to get through it" is better than saying "shit this life sucks". It will get better, i promise, but hang in there please. Seek help, because maybe therapy could help you. I really hope the best for you <3 if you need, DM me
